transport.tls: Client trusts only the managed CA file and verifies the hub DNS name; no system roots, no redirects, no proxies.

client_files.credential_helper_contract: No arguments. Runs as the Paseo login. Reads model_providers.clientproxy.experimental_bearer_token from ~/.codex/config.toml. Exit 0 with exactly the bearer and one newline on stdout; any failure exits nonzero with nothing on stdout.
client_files.ownership: All three are owned by root and not writable by group or other. The plugin refuses managed mode files that fail this check and stays in managed mode, unavailable.

synthesize.request_rules: Exactly these two keys. Any other key, including previous_text, next_text or model, is rejected as bad_request with no vendor call.

response_200.body: Raw signed 16-bit little-endian mono PCM at 24000 Hz, even length, at least 1 byte.

errors.client_rule: Any non-200, unknown code, wrong content type, missing audio header or oversize body is a failure the client explains; it never falls back to a direct vendor call.

pilot.fixture_text: The blue notebook is on the shelf.
pilot.fixture_rule: In fixture_only mode the hub accepts text equal to fixture_text byte for byte and nothing else.

hub_order_of_checks: parse and size-check the request; unknown route is not_found
bearer present and matches bearer_pattern, else unauthorized
identity map fresh (age <= identity_map_max_age_seconds), else auth_unavailable
bearer fingerprint maps to an active identity, else unauthorized
policy grant for that identity exists and is enabled, else not_granted
per-login rate and concurrency and hub concurrency, else rate_limited or busy
bounded GET /v1/models on the private CLIProxy with the same bearer returns 200, else unauthorized on 401/403 and auth_unavailable otherwise
voices: return policy voices allowed for the grant (no vendor call)
synthesize: voice_id allowed for the grant, else voice_not_allowed
synthesize: text passes the fixture rule, else text_not_allowed
synthesize: reserve len(text) characters against login and company monthly limits in one transaction, else quota_exceeded
synthesize: one vendor call with the hub's vendor key; failure is vendor_error and the reservation stays counted
